classification.method: 30-criterion HCU narrative analysis; largest-remainder normalization to 100
classification.note: Provisional narrative coordinates retained for revision 4 after editorial review of emphasis; not a ranking of beliefs, spiritual attainment or human worth.

rationale.HUMAN: First-person longing, dignity, recognition, loss of purpose and others' rights anchor the spiritual conflict.
rationale.LIGHT: Distinct meanings of self, pride and purification challenge premature equivalence; the contribution dispute tests willingness to accept correction.
rationale.DARK: Unresolved religious differences, unrepresented paths, nonbelief and recursive pride in humility or universal understanding keep the inquiry open.

unmapped_elements: The recursive attempt to achieve freedom from achievement is only partially represented by the three-center criteria.
Different religious accounts of selfhood and liberation are not reducible to three narrative weights.
The political economy of AI attribution and blockchain governance is not captured by narrative center weights.
coverage_audit.review_note: Human editorial review is pending. These coordinates cannot capture the metaphysical differences between traditions; no religion is assigned its own center score.
